verdict.rationale: 16-core/32-thread part with documented boost/PBO tuning (docs-10, docs-13, docs-21) is corroborated by independent reviews showing strong application/productivity performance and even a Linux developer/HN report of excellent compile-type performance benefiting from 3D cache (comm-1, comm-3, comm-6). missing for 10: dedicated multi-threaded compile benchmark numbers (e.g., Blender/Chromium build times) and more independent Linux-specific parallel workload benchmarks beyond one HN anecdote.
